column2: The Dragons are attacking her!? We've got to help!
Curse you! You dare interfere!? I'll show no mercy!!
No mercy!?
You're the Slum Queen!
You remember me? How lovely. It made searching for you worth it.
You were searching for me?
Yes... You saw it, didn't you? The Dragons attacking me? The Dragons are being controlled by the Demon King. They've abandoned the Slum King.
Don't tell me you want to hand me over to the Demon King to get the Dragons back to normal!?
I'm not that foolish. If I handed you over to the Demon King, something terrible would happen!
Then why were you looking for me?
I saw you heading for the "Hill of Beginnings" in a dream... That is my power: prophetic dreams.
Someday you'll head for the "Hill of Beginnings." To fight the Demon King! That is your fate!
My fate... Tell me! What happens to me!? And to {s}...!?
I don't know. But one thing is clear: you are the only one who can fight the Demon King.
Come with me. I'll have you meet the Slum King.
The Dragons aren't the only ones who've turned against the Slum King. All of them controlled by the Demon King, of course.
People falling under control is an omen of disaster. The Slum King understands that too. So he ordered me to search... for someone who can avert the worst.
...All right. I'll meet the Slum King!
Good boy...
I've been waiting, Slum Queen! Have you found the savior!?
I've brought him.
Well done! Excellent! O savior, come forth!
U-um... hello.
Slum Queen, what sort of joke is this?
This is the very person who will save Kanto, and the world, from disaster!
Uh, um, I'm {p}.
Ahahahahaha! Don't make me laugh! Slum Queen, it seems your powers have faded!
Then why not cross swords with him?
Whaaat!?
Ahahahahaha!\n\nYou'd have me fight a child?
If he crosses swords with you and dies, that means my prophetic dream was wrong. In that case, I shall die as well!
You'd stake that much on this child, Slum Queen... Then let us cross swords!
Come at me! {p}!
I've been bested...!!
Slum King, you'll acknowledge this boy now, won't you?
I have no choice!\n\n{p}! The Slum King will lend you his aid!
Y-yes, sir...!!
Slum Queen! Come with me!
{p}, that was splendid.
Thank you, Slum Queen-san!
Just a rumor, but they say the Slum King's in big trouble. Seems even some of the Dragons turned into rioters... What on earth is about to happen to Kanto...?
Isn't anyone here?
Today the girls have a physical exam, so do stay behind, darlings! Ohohoho! Boys, run along home now, mm-kay? Eehee hee...
...Not that there's anybody here to hear it... *Sigh*, I'm so wonewy...
What are you doing all by yourself...?
The world's gotten so dangerous, I hate it! And so the students stopped coming...
I haven't the money to go home, so I'll keep teaching all by my wittle self! Boo-hoo, boo-hoo, waaah!
Higegodzilla...
That voice...!?\n\nKyaaa! I'm sooo happy!
Mmmm, smooch! Smooch!
Knock it off! That's gross!
Ewww, stop it!
Whoa, what's with this guy!?
I'm so wonewy!\n\nPwease, take me with youuu! Pwetty pwease!
Fine, whatever. But you're my servant!
I kinda feel sorry for sensei... Okay, we'll take you along!
Fine, I'll talk to the Boss about it.
Kyaaa! I'm so happy! I'll follow you forever!!
How much does it cost to go home?
The base fare's 130 yen, darling! Once I'm through the ticket gate, the rest is... Eehee hee.
Oh my, I'm so vewy happy!
Mmmm, smooch! Smooch!
I'm so vewy happy I get to go home! Mommy!\n\nYour Sayuri is coming home now!
Smash it, smash it!
The Kigoku World no longer exists!
The Demon King will remake the world! No need for the Kigoku World! No need for the Dark Temple!
You...! The "Sun of rebirth" the Demon King seeks!?
If we hand you over, the Demon King will be pleased!
For the Demon King!
I thought it had gone quiet outside... You're the one who was with the Shutendoji, aren't you? You defeated the Kibutsu Clan for me.
Are you Kitani-san? You were inside the temple?
Even I can't do anything alone against so many of the Kibutsu Clan. I meant to take my own life inside the temple and set it ablaze. Well then...
...H-hey, wait!
I thought it had gone quiet outside... The Shutendoji, is it... What brings you to the temple?
That's none of your business!
It is! I must protect the temple from outside enemies!
Then why did you let the Kibutsu Clan do as they pleased?
Even I can't do anything alone against so many of the Kibutsu Clan. I meant to take my own life inside the temple and set it ablaze. Well then...
...H-hey, wait!
He may be my sworn enemy, but I can't abandon him.
No! You can't set the temple on fire!
No matter how much I pray, I hear nothing from the Kigoku World. This has never happened before...
Even the Kibutsu Clan has begun to defy me.\n\nWhy won't the Kigoku World answer my call!?
Maybe...!

...I see!

This is a patchwork world made by the Demon King, and my true world exists elsewhere!

And there, the Kigoku World is just as it always was!?
I can't say for sure, though.
No, I'm certain of it.\n\nBefore the black moon rose, the Kigoku World existed. I felt it, and the Kigoku World answered my call.
And now there's nothing at all?
That's right, {p}! I'll fight with you too! The Demon King is a grave enemy who threatens the very existence of the Kigoku World. How could I not fight him!
The one who guards the Kigoku World fighting alongside me, the one fated to destroy it... How ironic.
But you and I are sworn enemies! Don't forget that!
Same goes for you.
Let's go, {p}.
Man, that was a blast! Right, Dorano!
Hmph! I was planning to take Kedaman down when he let his guard slip, but I never got the chance...
